label: NECESSARY_1, said of a being in the…: IsNecessary: x cannot not-be
term: necessary (necessarium), said of a being in the tertia via
definition: `IsNecessary`: x cannot not-be (it is not possible that x is not). Possibility is a primitive over conditions on times, not defined as realization at some time. The tertia via allows necessary beings that have a cause of their necessity from elsewhere, so 'necessary' here does not mean 'uncaused'.
